$description: Commands the approved plan names that the CLI registry (harness/cli/commands/*.mts) may not have yet, so docs in .claude/ can mention them while another builder ships them (SB-0053). harness/cli/known.mts merges this with the registry into known-commands.json: a registry command wins over the entry with the same name, and its subcommands are the union of both. Delete an entry once the command lands.
